# Is it cheaper to repair or replace it this year?

> Free browser planner for trade and service fleets: cost out repair-versus-replace for every van, truck and machine including the downtime days most owners leave out, then rank which ones to replace against a fixed capital budget. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
